body:
Admits that he sought money by deceiving people through letters.

Recorded role and choices

Confronted in March 2025, Cyrus abandons his initial denial and says he hoped to trick people into sending gold. He insists that the scheme was conducted by post and denies personally meeting the correspondents. This specific deception is kept separate from Cynthia’s account of her relationship with Simon; Cyrus’s admissions do not explain away the other witnesses’ entire story.
